request.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction for an existing animation sprite sheet. Output the SAME 2048x1536 image with a genuine transparent alpha channel.

Remove ONLY the opaque white, pale gray, checker-like and smoky background from this supplied 12-cel sprite sheet. Every empty region, every cell margin, every central hole and every gap between magical strokes must become fully transparent alpha=0. Do not paint transparency as a checkerboard, gray paper or black background.

PRESERVE the existing independently drawn animation cels, not redesign them: same 4 columns by 3 rows, 512x512 cells, same fixed center, same coordinates, same sizes, same cyan/gold arc silhouettes and tiny separated curved shreds. Keep charcoal outlines, very pale cyan/cream highlights and the fine colored remnants. The progression of heads bending, tails splitting and fragments thinning is already correct. Do not replace it with a fade or a rescaled static ring. Do not move or reshape the arcs, do not add any stroke, particle or symbol, and do not re-center or fit cels. The nearly empty last cel becomes completely transparent.

The source accidentally has a white/gray cloudy matte; this matte is NOT part of the artwork and must be absent everywhere. Extract clean straight-alpha painted strokes with clean edges and no white fringe or gray aura. Preserve pale interior highlights as part of the arc artwork, so this is NOT simple white color-keying. Keep true transparent gaps where arcs have fractured. No labels, grid lines, borders, scenery, extra glow or background of any kind.
